verdict.rationale: Supabase explicitly supports branching environments and local/self-hosted dev stacks that let developers 'create and test changes... without affecting your production setup' (supabase-docs-10/17/24), plus a CLI to spin up a full local Supabase stack (supabase-docs-2/21/28) and self-hosting for isolated environments (supabase-docs-3/29/32) — all directly serving an AI-native sandbox-testing workflow. Missing for 10: explicit guidance tying the MCP/AI-assistant workflow itself to sandbox/branch usage — community evidence (supabase-comm-4) notes the MCP docs don't warn against pointing an AI agent at production, which is a documentation gap on this exact axis.
